Third-party assets used in Exit Clause

Poly Haven (https://polyhaven.com), CC0 1.0 (public domain), 2K JPG diffuse + OpenGL normal maps:
- red_brick_03            -> Textures/Brick
- cobblestone_floor_08    -> Textures/Cobblestone
- plastered_wall_04       -> Textures/Plaster
- asphalt_02              -> Textures/Asphalt, Textures/WetAsphalt
- concrete_wall_008       -> Textures/Concrete, Textures/ConcreteDark
- castle_wall_slates      -> Textures/Trim
